targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(snapshot_at::timestamp, '1h') AS time, SUM(nav_eur)::double precision AS portfolio_nav_eur FROM portfolio_value_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH aggregated AS (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(snapshot_at::timestamp, '1h') AS bucket,
           SUM(nav_eur) AS total_nav
    FROM portfolio_value_snapshot
    WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at)
    GROUP BY 1
),
returns AS (
    SELECT bucket AS time,
           total_nav,
           LAG(total_nav) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS prev_nav
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT time,
       (total_nav - prev_nav)::double precision AS value
FROM returns
WHERE prev_nav IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time;

WITH aggregated AS (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(snapshot_at::timestamp, '1h') AS bucket,
           SUM(nav_eur) AS total_nav
    FROM portfolio_value_snapshot
    WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at)
    GROUP BY 1
),
returns AS (
    SELECT bucket AS time,
           total_nav,
           LAG(total_nav) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS prev_nav
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT time,
       CASE
           WHEN prev_nav IS NULL OR prev_nav = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE ((total_nav / prev_nav) - 1) * 100
       END::double precision AS value
FROM returns
WHERE prev_nav IS NOT NULL AND prev_nav <> 0
ORDER BY time;

WITH base_currency AS (
    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT to_ccy FROM fx_rates ORDER BY date_utc DESC LIMIT 1), 'EUR') AS code
),
latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_at) AS snapshot_at FROM positions_snapshot
),
latest_prices AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (instrument_id) instrument_id, close, currency, as_of_utc
    FROM prices
    ORDER BY instrument_id, as_of_utc DESC
),
latest_fx AS (
    SELECT from_ccy, to_ccy, rate
    FROM (
        SELECT fr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY from_ccy, to_ccy ORDER BY date_utc DESC) AS rn
        FROM fx_rates fr
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
position_values AS (
    SELECT
        ps.account_id,
        ps.instrument_id,
        ps.shares,
        ps.cost_basis_eur,
        i.symbol,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(i.name, ''), i.symbol) AS name,
        COALESCE(lp.currency, i.currency) AS instrument_ccy,
        lp.close,
        bc.code AS base_ccy,
        CASE
            WHEN lp.close IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN COALESCE(lp.currency, i.currency) = bc.code THEN ps.shares * lp.close
            WHEN fx.rate IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE ps.shares * lp.close * fx.rate
        END AS market_value_base,
        CASE
            WHEN lp.close IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN COALESCE(lp.currency, i.currency) = bc.code THEN (ps.shares * lp.close) - ps.cost_basis_eur
            WHEN fx.rate IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (ps.shares * lp.close * fx.rate) - ps.cost_basis_eur
        END AS unrealized_pnl_base
    FROM positions_snapshot ps
    JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.snapshot_at = ps.snapshot_at
    JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = ps.instrument_id
    LEFT JOIN latest_prices lp ON lp.instrument_id = ps.instrument_id
    CROSS JOIN base_currency bc
    LEFT JOIN latest_fx fx
      ON fx.from_ccy = COALESCE(lp.currency, i.currency)
     AND fx.to_ccy = bc.code
    WHERE ps.shares <> 0
)
SELECT symbol || COALESCE(' – ' || name, '') AS label, SUM(unrealized_pnl_base)::double precision AS value
FROM position_values
WHERE unrealized_pnl_base IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY symbol, name
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT t.date_time_utc AS trade_time,
       t.account_id,
       i.symbol,
       t.type,
       t.qty,
       t.price,
       t.currency,
       t.net_amount,
       t.fees
FROM transactions t
JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.type NOT ILIKE 'DIV%'
ORDER BY t.date_time_utc DESC
LIMIT 25;

WITH base_currency AS (
    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT to_ccy FROM fx_rates ORDER BY date_utc DESC LIMIT 1), 'EUR') AS code
),
latest_fx AS (
    SELECT from_ccy, to_ccy, rate
    FROM (
        SELECT fr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY from_ccy, to_ccy ORDER BY date_utc DESC) AS rn
        FROM fx_rates fr
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
dividends AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', cm.date_time_utc) AS day,
        CASE
            WHEN cm.currency = bc.code THEN cm.amount
            WHEN fx.rate IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE cm.amount * fx.rate
        END AS amount_base
    FROM cash_movements cm
    CROSS JOIN base_currency bc
    LEFT JOIN latest_fx fx
      ON fx.from_ccy = cm.currency
     AND fx.to_ccy = bc.code
    WHERE $__timeFilter(cm.date_time_utc)
      AND (cm.movement_type ILIKE '%DIV%' OR cm.description ILIKE '%DIV%')
)
SELECT day AS time,
       SUM(amount_base)::double precision AS value
FROM dividends
WHERE amount_base IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;

WITH base_currency AS (
    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT to_ccy FROM fx_rates ORDER BY date_utc DESC LIMIT 1), 'EUR') AS code
),
latest_fx AS (
    SELECT from_ccy, to_ccy, rate
    FROM (
        SELECT fr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY from_ccy, to_ccy ORDER BY date_utc DESC) AS rn
        FROM fx_rates fr
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
dividends AS (
    SELECT
        cm.date_time_utc,
        cm.account_id,
        cm.movement_type,
        cm.description,
        cm.currency,
        cm.amount,
        bc.code AS base_currency,
        CASE
            WHEN cm.currency = bc.code THEN cm.amount
            WHEN fx.rate IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE cm.amount * fx.rate
        END AS amount_base
    FROM cash_movements cm
    CROSS JOIN base_currency bc
    LEFT JOIN latest_fx fx
      ON fx.from_ccy = cm.currency
     AND fx.to_ccy = bc.code
    WHERE cm.movement_type ILIKE '%DIV%' OR cm.description ILIKE '%DIV%'
)
SELECT date_time_utc,
       account_id,
       COALESCE(movement_type, 'Dividend') AS movement_type,
       description,
       currency,
       amount::double precision AS amount,
       amount_base::double precision AS amount_base,
       base_currency
FROM dividends
WHERE amount_base IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY date_time_utc DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT snapshot_at AS time, SUM(unrealized_pnl_eur)::double precision AS value, 'Unrealized' AS metric
FROM portfolio_value_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at)
GROUP BY snapshot_at
UNION ALL
SELECT snapshot_at AS time, SUM(realized_pnl_eur)::double precision AS value, 'Realized' AS metric
FROM portfolio_value_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at)
GROUP BY snapshot_at
ORDER BY time, metric;

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_at) AS snapshot_at FROM portfolio_value_snapshot)
SELECT account_id,
       nav_eur::double precision AS nav_eur,
       delta_eur::double precision AS delta_eur,
       (COALESCE(ret, 0) * 100)::double precision AS return_pct,
       realized_pnl_eur::double precision AS realized_pnl,
       unrealized_pnl_eur::double precision AS unrealized_pnl
FROM portfolio_value_snapshot p
JOIN latest l ON p.snapshot_at = l.snapshot_at
ORDER BY nav_eur DESC;

SELECT account_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN amount >= 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS contributions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS withdrawals
FROM cash_movements
WHERE date_time_utc >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY account_id;

SELECT
    account_id,
    symbol,
    name,
    shares::double precision AS shares,
    instrument_ccy AS currency,
    close::double precision AS last_price,
    as_of_utc AS price_as_of,
    cost_basis_eur::double precision AS cost_basis_eur,
    market_value_base::double precision AS market_value_eur,
    unrealized_pnl_base::double precision AS unrealized_pnl_eur,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(market_value_base) OVER () > 0 THEN (market_value_base / SUM(market_value_base) OVER ())
        ELSE NULL
    END::double precision AS portfolio_weight,
    sector,
    country,
    base_ccy AS base_currency
FROM position_values
WHERE market_value_base IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY market_value_base DESC;
